name: Laxmi India Finance Ltd
title: Laxmi India Finance Ltd - 544465 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Secured MSME/rural lender guiding 30-35% AUM CAGR and ~40-45% PAT growth; cost of borrowing fell to 10.8% but incremental cost is 10.25-10.30%, and Q4 PAT was flattered by an INR 8.66 cr DA upfront gain.

triggers.label: AUM CAGR 30-35%, PAT +40-45%
triggers.quote: we expect a compound growth of AUM at around 30% to 35% annually over the medium terms

triggers.label: Borrowing cost 11.48% → 10.80%
triggers.quote: Our average cost of borrowing reduced to 10.8% from 11.48% in financial '25

triggers.label: DA pool sale lifts Q4 NIM
triggers.quote: we recognize upfront profit on account of INR8 crores 66 lakh. This is included in our revenue and NIM

triggers.label: Incremental borrowing 10.25-10.30%
triggers.quote: the incremental cost stood to around 10.25% to 10.30%

triggers.label: Up Money INR19 cr balance, INR11 cr provided
triggers.quote: there was a balance of INR19 crores and we have made a provision of almost INR11 crores

guidance.quote: we expect a compound growth of AUM at around 30% to 35% annually over the medium terms
PAT expected growth at around 40% to 45% in current year
this year we will be getting an eventually benefit of around 20 to 25 bps
in the medium terms I can say that we believe that it will be above 12%, 12.5% on a minimum side

red_flags.label: DA upfront gain flatters Q4 NIM/PAT
red_flags.quote: In Quarter 4, we have done a DA of around of INR41 crores. So on the account of INR8 crores 66 lakhs are included in NIM.

red_flags.label: Up Money INR19 cr receivable under dispute
red_flags.quote: there was a balance of INR19 crores and we have made a provision of almost INR11 crores

red_flags.label: Evasive/ambiguous answers on stress and LTV
red_flags.quote: the 49% is a very healthy PCR what we are maintaining on this secured asset

red_flags.label: Collection efficiency moderation acknowledged
red_flags.quote: the broader industry environment witnessed some moderation in collection efficiency across certain borrower segments

evasions.quote: So we believe that we have a handsome recovery on our bad debts also.

evasions.topic: Q4 PAT growth vs customer growth
evasions.quote: This is PAT including the impact of also upfront profit on DA arrangement.
